channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Boeing expects to start delivering improved 787 Dreamliners in first half
item.description: SINGAPORE -- Boeing expects to begin delivering improved 787-9 and 787-10 Dreamliners to airlines in the first half of this year, enabling longer flights or greater cargo capability, a senior executive said on Wednesday.

item.title: Vietnam becomes 2nd home for int’l students
item.description: From small acts of trust to shared meals and holiday rituals, international students in Vietnam say everyday kindness has turned a once-unfamiliar country into a place they now call home.

item.title: Vietnam retailer Mobile World posts strong 2025 profit, boosted by financial income
item.description: Vietnam’s Mobile World Investment Corp (MWG) reported a sharp rise in profit in 2025, supported not only by a recovery in core retail operations but also by higher income from financial activities, according to its fourth-quarter financial statements.

item.title: Da Nang to host 6 fireworks shows on Lunar New Year’s Eve
item.description: Da Nang City in central Vietnam will stage fireworks displays at six locations on Lunar New Year’s Eve to celebrate the Year of the Horse with a festive atmosphere.

item.title: Sapporo snow festival opens in Japan with 210 sculptures
item.description: SAPPORO -- A popular annual snow festival kicked off in Sapporo, the capital of Hokkaido, northernmost Japan, on Wednesday, showcasing 210 ice and snow sculptures across three venues.

item.title: Japanese, Thai police discuss steps against human trafficking
item.description: BANGKOK -- Thai and Japanese police authorities agreed to closely cooperate to eradicate human trafficking after a Thai girl was discovered to have been forced to provide sexual services at a massage parlor in Tokyo.

item.title: Vietnam opens stock market wider to foreign investors
item.description: Vietnam’s Ministry of Finance has issued new regulations allowing foreign investors to trade through global brokerage firms without opening accounts at domestic securities companies, a move aimed at boosting the country’s upgrade to emerging market status.

item.title: Dog walking emerges as profitable line of work in Ho Chi Minh City
item.description: During the Lunar New Year holiday, pet services enter their busiest season, with dog walking increasingly sought after by busy owners and emerging as a lucrative line of work in Ho Chi Minh City.

item.title: Vietnam’s Khanh Hoa tightens oversight of foreign nationals to address safety, residency issues
item.description: Authorities in Khanh Hoa Province, home to the famed beach destination of Nha Trang in south-central Vietnam, have ordered stronger coordination among agencies to manage and address issues involving foreign nationals, including stricter checks on immigration, residency, and traffic violations.
